name: Gnawing Pulse
description: Send a slow gnawing pulse of soul force that wears at the target's will with every beat.

name: Reeling Grasp
description: Close a grasp round the target's sense of self until the world reels and loses its edges.

name: Shaking Press
description: Press down on the target's will with a trembling weight that makes every thought shake loose.

name: Lancing Thought
description: Hurl a single hard thought like a lance and drive it through the guard of the mind.

name: Rending Tide
description: Send a rolling tide of soul force over the field that tears at every unguarded will.

name: Unseating Blow
description: Strike so hard at the centre of the will that the soul is knocked from its seat for a breath.

name: Brittling Cold
description: Chill the target's will until it grows brittle and cracks at the touch of any further strain.

name: Emptied Lance
description: Gather a hollow lance of force over several breaths and run it through a heavily guarded soul.

name: Mind Reaping
description: Sweep a scythe of force across a soul and reap a measure of its will that no guard can protect.

name: Will Sundering
description: Break the will of one foe at its root so that it falls apart into separate and useless strands.

name: Unlatching
description: Throw open every latch of the target's will so that nothing in it can be held shut or held steady.

name: Lance Rain
description: The canon's rain of hollow lances that falls on a whole line of minds and leaves each ringing and empty.

name: Great Unminding
description: Loose the whole stored will in one stroke that empties every mind within the destructive ceiling of the tier.

name: Anchor Rattle
description: Rattle the cord that binds the target's soul to its core so every technique shudders.

name: Core Prick
description: Drive a narrow point down the cord of the soul to prick the core it hangs from.

name: Seated Dread
description: Seat a cold dread in the target's will that grows heavier each time they draw on power.

name: Wrenching Pull
description: Wrench the soul toward the user by its anchor and hold it off balance and unready.

name: Anchor Sunder
description: Cut through the anchor in a single stroke and leave the soul swaying loose from its core.

name: Shell Splitting
description: Split the hard outer shell that the soul wears about the core with a gathered wedge of force.

name: Rung Drop
description: Press the target's soul down a step so that its techniques come at a lower strength for a time.

name: Great Hush
description: Drop a vast hush across the field that stills every soul it covers for a long breath.

name: Anchor Unmaking
description: Pull the anchor out of a soul entirely and wound the soul past any guard it still holds.

name: Soul Rending
description: Tear the soul along its length with a stroke that cannot be turned by any ward of will.

name: Heart Silence
description: Seal the heart of the target's will in a deep silence that no urging can break.

name: Severing Anchor
description: The treatise's stroke where the anchor is cut and the loosened soul is held in place to be broken.

name: Soul Eclipse
description: Throw a great shadow over the target's soul that smothers its light up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Final Unmaking
description: Undo a soul at its anchor in a single stroke whose ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of the tier.
